region_slavonija_page_title: Slavonia - Golden Plain of Tradition and Hospitality
region_slavonija_description_detailed: Discover the magical plain where tradition and hospitality meet in perfect harmony.
region_slavonija_long_description: Slavonia, a region of golden fields and rich cultural heritage, invites you to explore its hidden gems. From magnificent castles and historic fortresses to picturesque villages and authentic gastronomic experiences, this region offers an unforgettable journey through time. Enjoy the warm hospitality of the locals, taste traditional dishes and wines, and experience authentic folk customs passed down through generations. Whether you are exploring Kopački Rit, strolling through the streets of Osijek, or enjoying Slavonian music and dance, Slavonia will enchant you with its simplicity and beauty.
transport_slavonija_airplane_details: The nearest airports are Osijek (international) and Zagreb (major international hub, approx. 2.5h drive by highway).
transport_slavonija_car_details: Slavonia is excellently connected by the modern A3 highway (Bregana-Zagreb-Lipovac) and A5 (Beli Manastir-Osijek-Svilaj).
transport_slavonija_bus_details: Regular bus lines connect major Slavonian cities with the rest of Croatia and Europe.
transport_slavonija_train_details: The railway network covers major cities, with direct lines from Zagreb.
accommodation_slavonija_example_hotel_de: Modern hotel in the center of Osijek overlooking the Drava River.
accommodation_slavonija_example_rural_de: Authentic Slavonian experience with traditional food.
food_slavonija_kulen_desc: Spicy cured sausage, the pride of Slavonia.
food_slavonija_fis_paprikas_desc: Spicy fish stew, an indispensable specialty.
activities_slavonija_kopacki_rit_desc: Boat ride and bird watching in a unique nature park.
activities_slavonija_wine_tour_desc: Tasting of top-quality wines in famous Slavonian vineyards.
events_slavonija_vinkovacke_jeseni_desc: The largest festival of original Croatian folklore.
sights_slavonija_osijek_tvrdja_desc: Baroque city core from the 18th century.
sights_slavonija_djakovo_cathedral_desc: An imposing cathedral, one of the most beautiful in Croatia.
region_dalmacija_page_title: Dalmatia - Magical Coast of a Thousand Islands
region_dalmacija_description_detailed: Explore crystal clear seas, ancient cities, and sun-kissed islands of this Mediterranean paradise.
region_dalmacija_long_description: Dalmatia, the pearl of the Adriatic, is a place where history and natural beauty meet. From UNESCO-protected cities like Split and Dubrovnik to hidden coves and pristine islands, this region offers endless opportunities for exploration. Walk the stone streets of ancient cities, discover the secrets of Roman palaces and medieval fortresses, or simply enjoy the crystal clear sea and Mediterranean climate. Dalmatian cuisine, rich in fresh seafood, olive oil, and local spices, will further enrich your experience. Surrender to the charms of Dalmatian music, meet the cordial hosts, and create memories that will last forever.
transport_dalmacija_airplane_details: International airports in Split (SPU), Dubrovnik (DBV), and Zadar (ZAD) connect Dalmatia with numerous European cities.
transport_dalmacija_car_details: The modern A1 highway (Zagreb-Split-Dubrovnik) is the main road link through Dalmatia.
transport_dalmacija_bus_details: Major Dalmatian cities are well connected by regular bus lines to the rest of Croatia and neighboring countries.
transport_dalmacija_train_details: The Zagreb-Split railway line connects the interior with the coast; other lines are less frequent.
transport_dalmacija_boat_details: Numerous ferry and catamaran lines connect the coast with the islands. Main ports: Split, Zadar, Dubrovnik, Šibenik.
accommodation_dalmacija_example_hotel_de: Luxury hotel with a tradition, located next to Bačvice beach.
accommodation_dalmacija_example_apartmen: Modern apartments in Hvar town with a sea view.
food_dalmacija_pasticada_desc: Traditional Dalmatian dish of beef slow-cooked in wine and spices, served with gnocchi.
food_dalmacija_brudet_desc: A rich fish stew made with various types of fish and seafood.
activities_dalmacija_np_krka_desc: Discover travertine waterfalls, take a boat trip, and swim under Skradinski Buk.
activities_dalmacija_sailing_desc: Explore the beauty of Kornati National Park, a unique island labyrinth.
events_dalmacija_ultra_europe_desc: One of the world's largest electronic music festivals, held in Split.
sights_dalmacija_dubrovnik_walls_desc: Impressive medieval walls surrounding the old city of Dubrovnik, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
sights_dalmacija_dioklecian_palace_desc: Ancient Roman palace that forms the heart of Split, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
region_istra_page_title: Istria - Magical Peninsula of Millennial History
region_istra_description_detailed: Experience a blend of Mediterranean beauty, Roman history, and Venetian architecture.
region_istra_long_description: Istria, an enchanting peninsula in northwestern Croatia, is a place where different cultures and traditions meet. From picturesque coastal towns like Rovinj and Poreč to hidden medieval settlements in the interior, Istria offers a unique mix of Mediterranean charm and Central European elegance. Explore the Roman amphitheater in Pula, get lost in the narrow streets of Motovun, or enjoy the beautiful beaches of the Adriatic Sea. Known for its excellent gastronomy, Istria is a paradise for gourmets - taste world-renowned olive oil, truffles, Istrian prosciutto, and local wines. Whether you are looking for an active holiday, cultural richness, or simply relaxation, Istria has something for everyone.
transport_istra_airplane_details: The nearest airport is Pula (PUY). Alternatively, Trieste (TRS) and Rijeka (RJK) airports are relatively close.
transport_istra_car_details: Istria is excellently connected by a network of highways ('Istrian Y') to the rest of Croatia and Slovenia.
transport_istra_bus_details: Regular bus lines connect major Istrian towns with each other and with Croatia and Europe.
transport_istra_train_details: A railway connection exists but is less extensive; the main line connects Pula with the interior.
transport_istra_boat_details: Ferry and catamaran lines connect coastal towns (e.g., Pula, Rovinj, Poreč) with islands and Venice (seasonal).
accommodation_istra_example_1_desc: Design hotel in Rovinj with top service and sea views.
accommodation_istra_example_2_desc: Luxury estate with vineyards and olive groves in the Istrian hinterland.
food_istra_example_1_desc: Traditionally cured ham, protected designation of origin.
food_istra_example_2_desc: Indigenous pasta with prized Istrian truffles.
activities_istra_example_1_desc: Bike ride along the restored route of an old narrow-gauge railway.
activities_istra_example_2_desc: Discover the natural beauty and historical heritage of the Brijuni archipelago.
events_istra_example_1_desc: The oldest film festival in Croatia, held in the Pula Arena.
sights_istra_example_1_desc: Magnificent Roman amphitheater, one of the six largest preserved in the world.
sights_istra_example_2_desc: UNESCO World Heritage site, a masterpiece of Byzantine art.
region_sredisnja_hrvatska_page_title: Central Croatia - The Green Heart of the Country
region_sredisnja_hrvatska_description_de: Discover fairytale castles, thermal springs, and untouched nature in the heart of Croatia.
region_sredisnja_hrvatska_long_descripti: Central Croatia, a region of picturesque hills, vineyards, and historic castles, represents the authentic Croatian soul. Here you will find a perfect blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage. Explore fairytale castles like Trakošćan and Veliki Tabor, relax in the thermal springs of Zagorje, or enjoy a walk through beautiful nature parks. The region is known for its rich gastronomic offer, traditional dishes, and quality wines. Visit picturesque towns like Varaždin with its baroque architecture or discover the charms of rural tourism in gentle villages. The hospitality of the hosts and authentic experiences will make your stay in Central Croatia unforgettable.
transport_sredisnja_hrvatska_airplane_de: The nearest airport is Zagreb (ZAG), which is excellently connected to the region.
transport_sredisnja_hrvatska_car_details: The region is well covered by a network of highways (A1, A2, A3, A4) and state roads.
transport_sredisnja_hrvatska_bus_details: Bus lines regularly connect the cities of Central Croatia with the rest of the country.
transport_sredisnja_hrvatska_train_detai: The railway network is developed, with the main hub in Zagreb.
accommodation_sredisnja_hrvatska_example: Accommodation in a historic castle with modern amenities in Hrvatsko Zagorje.
Modern thermal resort with a rich offer of wellness and spa facilities.
food_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_1_desc: Traditional dish of pulled dough filled with cheese, can be boiled or baked.
food_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_2_desc: Festive dish, roasted turkey served with homemade mlinci (thin dried flatbread).
activities_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_1_: Explore one of the most beautiful and best-preserved castles in Croatia.
activities_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_2_: Numerous hiking and walking trails in Medvednica Nature Park.
events_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_1_desc: Street festival of good emotions with a rich music and art program.
sights_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_1_desc: Medieval fortress, a symbol of the city of Varaždin.
sights_sredisnja_hrvatska_example_2_desc: One of the most modern museums in Europe, dedicated to the Neanderthal site.
region_zagreb_page_title: Zagreb - Vibrant Metropolis of Rich Culture
region_zagreb_description_detailed: Explore the charming capital where history and modernity meet in perfect harmony.
region_zagreb_long_description: Zagreb, the capital of Croatia, combines Central European charm with a Mediterranean spirit. A city of millennial history invites you to explore its two historic cores - the medieval Upper Town with Kaptol and the Lower Town squares and parks from the 19th century. Stroll down Tkalčićeva Street, visit the Museum of Broken Relationships, or enjoy the view from Lotrščak Tower. Zagreb is a city of culture with numerous museums, galleries, and theaters, but also a city with a lively atmosphere with numerous cafes, restaurants, and events throughout the year. From Advent festivities in winter to summer festivals, Zagreb always offers something new to discover. Meet the friendly Zagrebians, taste local specialties, and experience the authentic atmosphere of this charming city.
transport_zagreb_airplane_details: Franjo Tuđman Airport Zagreb (ZAG) is Croatia's main air hub.
transport_zagreb_car_details: Zagreb is a key transport hub in Croatia, with highways leading in all directions.
transport_zagreb_bus_details: Zagreb's main bus station offers numerous intercity and international lines.
transport_zagreb_train_details: Zagreb's main railway station is the central point of railway traffic in the country.
accommodation_zagreb_example_1_desc: Iconic luxury hotel with a long history and top service.
accommodation_zagreb_example_2_desc: Elegant boutique hotel in the city center with personalized service.
food_zagreb_example_1_desc: Breaded veal cutlet stuffed with ham and cheese.
food_zagreb_example_2_desc: Traditional Zagreb cheese pastry, similar to Zagorje štrukli.

activities_zagreb_example_1_desc: Discover historic streets, St. Mark's Square, and the Stone Gate.
activities_zagreb_example_2_name: Visit the Museum of Broken Relationships

sights_zagreb_example_1_desc: The tallest sacral building in Croatia, a symbol of Zagreb.
sights_zagreb_example_2_desc: Zagreb's central square, a popular meeting place.
region_lika_gorski_kotar_page_title: Lika and Gorski Kotar - Wild Beauty of Untouched Nature
region_lika_gorski_kotar_description_det: Experience the magic of national parks, mountain peaks, and crystal clear rivers.
region_lika_gorski_kotar_long_descriptio: Lika and Gorski Kotar, regions of untouched wilderness and stunning natural beauty, are a true haven for nature lovers. Here are some of Croatia's most beautiful national parks - Plitvice Lakes with its magical waterfalls, the magnificent Velebit, and the mysterious Risnjak. Explore deep forests, crystal clear rivers, and impressive mountain peaks. This region offers perfect conditions for an active holiday - hiking, cycling, rafting, or simply enjoying peace and quiet far from the city bustle. Get to know the traditional way of life of the local population, taste indigenous dishes prepared according to centuries-old recipes, and experience authentic Croatia in its most natural edition.
transport_lika_gorski_kotar_airplane_det: The nearest airports are Rijeka (RJK) and Zagreb (ZAG).
transport_lika_gorski_kotar_car_details: The A1 highway passes through Lika, while Gorski Kotar is accessible via the A6 (Zagreb-Rijeka).
transport_lika_gorski_kotar_bus_details: Bus lines connect larger towns with the rest of Croatia.
transport_lika_gorski_kotar_train_detail: Railway lines pass through both regions, but services are less frequent.
accommodation_lika_gorski_kotar_example_: Accommodation in the heart of Plitvice Lakes National Park.
Authentic mountain accommodation in Risnjak National Park.
food_lika_gorski_kotar_example_1_desc: Famous lamb from Lika pastures, often spit-roasted.
food_lika_gorski_kotar_example_2_desc: Rich goulash made from game meat with mushrooms and forest fruits.

events_lika_gorski_kotar_example_1_desc: Traditional exhibition of indigenous products and customs in Gospić.
sights_lika_gorski_kotar_example_1_desc: Untouched wilderness with impressive mountain peaks and trails.
sights_lika_gorski_kotar_example_2_desc: Birth house and museum dedicated to the great inventor Nikola Tesla.
region_kvarner_page_title: Kvarner - Where Mountains Meet the Sea
region_kvarner_description_detailed: Discover a unique blend of mountain peaks and beautiful islands embraced by the blue Adriatic.
region_kvarner_long_description: Kvarner, an enchanting region where mountains descend to the very sea, offers a unique combination of natural beauty and cultural richness. From elegant Opatija with its Austro-Hungarian architecture to vibrant Rijeka, the European Capital of Culture, Kvarner has something for every taste. Explore the magical islands - Krk, Cres, Lošinj, and Rab, each with its unique personality and beautiful beaches. Enjoy an active holiday on Učka mountain or indulge in relaxation in the healing sea air. Kvarner cuisine, known for fresh seafood, lamb, and indigenous herbs, will further enrich your experience. Whether you are looking for a luxury vacation, an adventurous experience, or cultural richness, Kvarner will meet all your expectations.
transport_kvarner_airplane_details: Rijeka Airport (RJK) is located on the island of Krk and is the main airport of the region.
transport_kvarner_car_details: The A6 (Zagreb-Rijeka) and A7 (Rupa-Rijeka-Žuta Lokva) highways are the main road connections.
transport_kvarner_bus_details: Rijeka is the main bus hub with numerous lines to the islands and the mainland.
transport_kvarner_train_details: Rijeka is connected by rail to Zagreb and the rest of Europe.
transport_kvarner_boat_details: Numerous ferry and catamaran lines connect Rijeka and coastal towns with the Kvarner islands (Krk, Cres, Lošinj, Rab).
accommodation_kvarner_example_1_desc: The oldest hotel on the Croatian Adriatic coast, a symbol of Opatija tourism.
accommodation_kvarner_example_2_desc: Luxury hotel in Čikat Bay, a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
food_kvarner_example_1_desc: Prized scampi from the Kvarner Gulf, known for their quality.

sights_kvarner_example_2_desc: Picturesque medieval town with four bell towers on the island of Rab.
